# Code Anchors: Nexus Pipeline

- `components/commands/nxs.setup.md` — the setup stage: bootstrap ground truth and product context.
- `components/commands/nxs.discover.md` — the discovery stage, run before the epic stage and only when the initiative is underspecified.
- `components/commands/nxs.epic.md` — the epic stage: intent to right-sized epic and filed stories, committing nothing at planning.
- `components/commands/nxs.decision-record.md` — the decision-record stage: files the record as an approvable sub-issue of the epic issue.
- `components/commands/nxs.analyze.md` — the analyze stage: refuses to run while the record is unapproved, and refuses an entry that has no criteria to check.
- `components/commands/nxs.close.md` — the close stage: blocks on any open sub-issue and closes the epic issue.
- `components/commands/nxs.fix.md` — the lane beside these stages, taken by a change too small to justify them; it files nothing and gates nothing.
- `README.md` — the numbered pipeline read-out.
- `how-to-nexus.md` — the stage table and plain-English walkthrough.
- `CLAUDE.md` — the one-line pipeline statement.
